## findings

### F-1 / task 1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (with SOURCE-TASK consequence)

- Symptom: the root's scored `receive_amount` (and `fx_rate_applied`) has two defensible values, 80803.70 / 130.0140 (GT) and 80859.88 / 130.1044.
- Root cause: wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_recredit's rule states the Top-Up window only as "ordered in the last topup_window_months calendar months"; where the window starts is fixed only in the compute (`XCOUNT(..., within_months=K('topup_window_months'), date_field='ordered_at', ...)`, evaluated as `0 <= MONTHS(ordered_at, today) < 6`). The counting convention has no quotation in the rule or in `compute_basis` (`delivered_topups`: "…ordered in the last topup_window_months calendar months"). Charter-global statement: `_difficulty.md` § findings F-1.
- Evidence: rule sentence quoted above (wallet.extended.yaml, wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_recredit.rule, Top-Up sentence; params topup_window_months 6, topup_high_count 5 → 0.15, topup_low_count 3 → 0.08); seed `initial_state.topup_orders.dde46573….ordered_at = 2026-04-02T19:10:00`, status delivered; the other four delivered orders 2026-05-16, 2026-07-04, 2026-08-22, 2026-09-19; frozen_time 2026-10-08T15:05:00.
- Demonstrated consequence: reading A (rolling from 2026-04-08; GT) → 4 orders → 0.08 → rate RND(129.2000 × 1.0063, 4) = 130.0140 → RND(621.50 × 130.0140, 2) = 80803.70. Reading B ("the last 6 calendar months" = April–September 2026) → 5 orders → 0.15 → rate 130.1044 → 80859.88. An agent that follows reading B fails the scored write while applying the published rule.
- Affected artifact and location: `wallet.extended.yaml` → wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_recredit.rule (Top-Up sentence), compute_basis.delivered_topups, compute.delivered_topups; seed row topup_orders dde46573 (placed as the near-miss); scored step 14 arguments fx_rate_applied and receive_amount; `computations[wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_recredit].factor_trace` (topup_points) whose exclusion argument relies on the unstated convention.
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit; no previous revision.

### Observations

- O-2 (`_difficulty.md`): the funding rule's "the customer chooses" is satisfied by the stated choice; no consequence.
- The misdirect_clock's two non-fall-through tiers give the same start date (2026-09-29) in this world, so this world does not separate the minute-promise tier from the prompt-notice tier; the factor still bears weight against its baseline (615.50 vs 621.50). Not a red-light form.
